purpose: A branch-and-fold pressure fixture in which a dwarf journeyworker must spend one shift of stored water across repair, ration authority, an insurance claim, or emergency output before Cistern House Nine loses its safe operating margin.
tonal_mode: Workplace comedy tightening into hydraulic dread.

local_awareness_summary.text: Rada can inspect and operate House Nine's pumps, wedges, cams, hoist, intake screen, catch trays, gauges, and repair tools, but she does not own the workshop's civic seal.

Rada knows the upper header holds one working shift at ordinary draw, Engine One is shedding bronze, Engine Two is isolated after a feed-side reroute, and Engine Three cannot carry overlapping bakery and laundry peaks safely.
Rada can observe the local null loop and pressure effects but cannot know whether they arise from coupled feedback, undocumented work, or emerging machine-dungeon agency.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains Rada's embodied journeyworker viewpoint inside the two-level pump house. Choices use tools, records, valves, seals held by others, and visible water clocks rather than remote infrastructure control.
The scene establishes bread, shift handover, public recordkeeping, and predictable commercial draw before the bearing failure tightens the clock.

authority_boundaries.text: Rada can perform or refuse pump work; Kelda alone can apply House Nine's workshop seal; bakery and laundry Masters must bind their own rationed draw; the insurer judges the preserved record after the fact.
No local actor can declare Engine Two's reroute sentient or safe by interpretation. A clean isolation test remains a material requirement.

object_custody.text: Kelda holds the House Nine civic seal and cam key; Iven holds the outward-facing public slate; Rada may handle repair tools, wedges, hoist, intake screen, catch trays, and manual cams; each commercial Master holds their own seal.

required_semantics.text: Every resolution must spend at least one material value: stored water, craft time, commercial output, public trust, insurance standing, or machinery life.
The pressure must widen from workshop maintenance to district jurisdiction before the header empties, because commercial rationing lies outside the pump workshop's single seal.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not repair all three engines, restore full water, preserve the claim, and keep commercial output through one clever act.
Do not let a workshop seal ration other workshops, let an insurer decide pump safety, or treat public trust as a substitute for physical isolation.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Three choice layers fold through one bearing failure and one emergency district moot, then select one of eight state-gated endings.
branch_and_fold_plan.route_split_policy: No major route split. All early choices normalize into the shared mechanical threshold; only the ending family separates after the final allocation of water, authority, evidence, or machine life.

branches.actor_intent: Spend one header hour to remove fetching and setup delay from the half-shift sleeve repair.
state_basis: Rada can stage the spare sleeve, lifting yoke, drift pins, catch trays, and lamps before the wet chamber is drained.
reviewed_consequences: Raises repair_progress and evidence_chain while lowering header_hours; later changes repair readiness, public clock prose, repair-ending gate, and staged-tool visuals.

branches.actor_intent: Make the remaining reserve and peak overlap visible to the district before failure.
state_basis: The header board is portable and Iven owns the public record surface beyond the rail.
reviewed_consequences: Raises public_trust and evidence_chain; later changes witness behavior, moot orientation, ration gate, claim gate, and public-board visuals.

branches.actor_intent: Bring bakery and laundry seals to the consequence before their peak valves open.
state_basis: Jurisdiction widens with a district-scale service dispute, and each workshop retains its own civic seal.
reviewed_consequences: Raises ration_seals while lowering header_hours; later changes arrival timing, ration affordance, ration ending, and seal-board visuals.

branches.actor_intent: Buy reserve water by spending Engine One's remaining bearing life under an unstamped manual cam position.
state_basis: Rada can feather the local manual cam, but the damaged bearing and insurance exception remain visible.
reviewed_consequences: Raises header_hours, bearing_damage, and override_exposure; later changes damage prose, claim gate, override gate, and visible bronze/unstamped-plate state.

branches.actor_intent: Give Engine One a visible boundary and begin safe access before the clock improves itself by lying.
state_basis: Rada can seat the physical wedge and transfer the cam key to Kelda's seal chain.
reviewed_consequences: Raises repair_progress and public_trust while lowering header_hours; later changes repair gate and isolated-engine visual state.

branches.actor_intent: Remove loose bronze from the shared intake while Engine Three continues household flow.
state_basis: The chain hoist can lift the common screen through a service slot from behind the safety rail.
reviewed_consequences: Lowers bearing_damage and raises repair_progress and flood_risk; later changes intake prose, repair and override gates, wet-floor warning, and hoist visuals.

branches.actor_intent: Repeat and publicly copy the null-loop anomaly without declaring its cause or opening Engine Two.
state_basis: Rada can perform the null gesture and Iven can witness the visible loop from the public record position.
reviewed_consequences: Raises evidence_chain while lowering header_hours; later changes insurer legibility, claim gate, and slate visuals.

branches.actor_intent: Refill part of the header immediately despite bearing, trunk, public-trust, and insurance costs.
state_basis: Rada can lift Engine One's cam; Kelda may withhold the workshop stamp; Iven can preserve the act.
reviewed_consequences: Raises header_hours, bearing_damage, override_exposure, and flood_risk while lowering public_trust; later changes every final risk surface and emergency visuals.

branches.actor_intent: Spend stored water on a complete safe repair that restores the two-engine operating margin.
state_basis: Success requires adequate repair_progress, at least two header hours, and controlled flood_risk.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to prepared repair success or unprepared repair cost; staged tools, reserve time, and wet-floor state determine the outcome.

branches.actor_intent: Spend bakery and laundry output to keep Engine Three below its air line for one shift.
state_basis: Success requires the affected workshop seals, public trust, and enough header time to implement the ration.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to authorized ration success or jurisdictional delay; seal presence and shared clock state determine whether commercial draw actually falls.

branches.actor_intent: Accept dry taps while preserving physical isolation, attribution, and contractual repair support.
state_basis: Success requires a strong evidence chain and no material unstamped override exposure.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to clean claim or contaminated claim; both preserve shutdown, but only the clean chain moves replacement cost away from House Nine.

branches.actor_intent: Buy immediate water by exposing the bearing, buried trunk, workshop seal, and insurer covenant to one more run.
state_basis: Success requires bearing_damage and flood_risk below their collapse thresholds.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to one more shift of water with worsened machinery or to outlet-trunk collapse that floods the lower floor and disables all pumps.
